description: Free. For x402 sellers, priced per endpoint per 30 days: Watch $5 (hourly quote checks, weekly test-buy), Watch Pro $20 (15 min checks, daily buys on up to 3 chains, limited by the test-buy budget, signed monthly report); 10+ endpoints -20% or 3 terms prepaid -10% (not stacked: the larger applies). Audit $99 one-off. Test-buy packs, one-off, valid 12 months, buys capped at $0.10 each: Re-test pack $6.50 for 30 test-buys ("Fixed something? Get re-tested now"), Founder pack $5 for 24 test-buys (first 10 sellers, one place per company, rebuy up to 12 times). Free Watch tier (1 endpoint, daily quote check, no test-buys) and a one-per-seller 14-day Watch trial (no card, never converts; on day 14 nothing is charged, checks stop, the badge comes off and history freezes read-only). Monitor, Monitor Plus and Watch Plus are no longer sold; existing terms run to their end. No auto-renew; payTo proven by signature; paying never changes a score. No args: plans, enrolment steps and safeguards. enrollment_id: that seller's public entry (disclosure, findings, replies) and live badge status. Plans are paid over x402 at the REST URL.
